reason: I always forget pills at home and travel a lot, so a sachet with my 2 capsules already counted that I can toss in my bag is actually useful. The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box guarantee make it low risk to try one box at $24.99.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle, and I could be 30 days in with no idea if it did anything.
